 Martha Stewart just gave this ‘beautifully done’ silk shirt a rave review, and it’s only $90 
 By 
 Erica Radol 
 Published 
 Oct. 29, 2026, 12:39 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results.

 Martha Stewart is the latest star to co-sign Quince's style staples.

 Martha Stewart may be worth millions, but her latest fashion find is surprisingly easy on the wallet. 
 The serial entrepreneur recently chatted with Sid Gupta, CEO of Quince, on her eponymously named podcast . And while discussing the brand’s accessible luxury business model, she wore one of its elevated styles: the Washable Stretch Silk Split Neck Blouse .
 “This is not going to fall apart. This is beautifully done,” the lifestyle magnate said of the $90 top, as she gave it a once-over.
 Quince Washable Stretch Silk Split Neck Blouse 
 Quince 
 BUY NOW $89.90 
 Stewart wore the Vintage Pink shade — paired with chocolate-brown pants for a chic, stealth wealth look — but it also comes in many other options, including a few limited-edition hues. Made from premium mulberry silk with a touch of stretch, the under-$100 blouse can even be tossed in the washing machine.
 “I always look at the stitchery, and you have many, many stitches per inch,” Stewart added. 
“That’s the sign of a very good manufacturer.” 
 “We didn’t even steam it, and it still looks okay,” she even quipped.
 Martha Stewart wore a Quince silk blouse during her podcast interview with the brand’s CEO, Sid Gupta. marthastewart48/instagram 
 Brand fans also rate the shirt highly, with one writing, “Love the rich, buttery feel of this gorgeous blouse! I usually wear M, but ordered S so it would be a bit more fitted. It’s perfect!” 
 “Beautiful silk blouse. I got the green and wore it for the first time today to work and got more compliments than I can ever remember getting on a shirt,” reads another review. 
Likewise, stylish stars like Jessica Alba have been spotted in the brand’s coveted cashmere . Whether shopping for yourself or for a gift, consider stocking up on these celeb-favorites ahead of the holidays.
